01374 Gebiym {ge:-vi:m'}

01356 的複數型; 專有名詞 地名

欽定本 - Gebim 1; 1

基柄 = "貯水槽"
1) 耶路撒冷北邊的村子, 顯然位於亞拿突 (今 Anata 亞拿塔)
   和挪伯城所在的山脊之間 (#賽 10:31|)

01374 Gebiym {gay-beem'}

plural of 01356;; n pr loc

AV - Gebim 1; 1

Gebim = "cisterns"
1) a village north of Jerusalem apparently between Anathoth (modern
    Anata) and the ridge on which Nob was situated
